from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
import datetime

def format_invoice_line(year, month, day, amount):
    # Fiscal quarter
    quarter = (month - 1) // 3 + 1
    quarter_label = f'Q{quarter}'
    
    # Date string
    date_str = datetime.date(year, month, day).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    
    # Round half up (away from zero)
    d = Decimal(str(amount))
    rounded = d.quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    
    if rounded < 0:
        amount_str = f'({-rounded:.2f})'
    else:
        amount_str = f'{rounded:.2f}'
    
    return f'{quarter_label} {date_str} {amount_str}'
